'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Russia]]n [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Ministry of Defense]] claims soldiers captured the village of [[Marynivka, Donetsk Oblast|Marynivka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/09/27/russia-takes-control-of-village-in-eastern-ukraine-defense-ministry (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Kryvyi Rih strikes (2022–present)|Kryvyi Rih strikes]]
***At least one person is killed and five others are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[missile]] strike on a [[National Police of Ukraine|police department]] in [[Kryvyi Rih]], [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-ukraines-kryvyi-rih-strikes-police-department-2024-09-27/ (Reuters)]
**[[Nuclear risk during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Belarusian involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] warns that [[Belarus]] will use [[Russia and weapons of mass destruction| Russian nuclear weapons]] if the country is attacked by [[NATO]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/belarus-says-will-use-nuclear-weapons-in-case-of-an-attack/3343608 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***Russian [[loitering munition]]s hit the city of [[Izmail]] in [[Odesa Oblast]], Ukraine, killing three people and wounding fourteen. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-southern-town-izmail-kills-3-injures-14-2024-09-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[September 2024 Lebanon strikes]]
***[[Israel]] carries out several [[airstrike]]s using [[bunker buster]] bombs on [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], killing six people, injuring about a hundred and destroying six buildings. These also targeted [[Hezbollah]]'s central headquarters to [[Assassination of Hassan Nasrallah|assassinate]] its leader, [[Hassan Nasrallah]]. [https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1428766/houthis-launch-nighttime-rocket-atttack-on-tel-aviv-day-357-of-the-gaza-and-lebanon-wars.html (''L'Orient le Jour'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/27/israel-attacks-lebanon-israeli-bombings-kill-more-than-700-in-lebanon?update=3206525 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/rkeh1ynra (Ynet News)]
***A second wave of airstrikes hits three buildings in Beirut. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/27/israel-attacks-lebanon-israeli-bombings-kill-more-than-700-in-lebanon?update=3206964 (Al Jazeera)]
**Israel launches an [[airstrike]] against a [[Syria]]n military post in the [[countryside]] near [[Damascus]], killing five [[Syrian Army|soldiers]] and injuring another. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/09/27/five-syrian-soldiers-killed-in-israeli-strike-on-damascus-countryside-report (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**An aid worker of a [[United States]]-based charity is shot and killed in her car by [[Palestinian]] gunmen near [[Khan Yunis]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [[Hamas government in the Gaza Strip|Gazan government officials]] claim that the gunmen had mistakenly identified the vehicle. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/09/27/gunmen-shoot-and-kill-aid-worker-in-gaza-charity-and-family-say (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] reports that at least 3,661 people, including 100 children, have been killed in the first six months of the year by ongoing gang violence in [[Haiti]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/27/at-least-3661-killed-in-senseless-haiti-gang-violence-this-year-un (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**At least 18 people are killed when the [[Rapid Support Forces]] attack a market in [[Al-Fashir]], [[Sudan]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/09/27/medic-says-18-dead-in-sudan-s-el-fasher-after-paramilitary-attack-on-market (Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Helene (2024)|Hurricane Helene]]
***At least 17 people are killed and more than 900,000 people are reported to be without power due to high winds and [[flooding]] caused by Hurricane Helene in [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]]. A rare [[flash flood warning|flash flood emergency]] is also issued for the [[Metro Atlanta|Atlanta metropolitan area]]. [https://www.cnn.com/weather/live-news/hurricane-helene-florida-georgia-09-27-24 (CNN)]
***The [[Walters Dam]] in [[Tennessee]] was reported to have suffered a [[catastrophic failure]] due to ongoing heavy rainfall, with [[Cocke County, Tennessee|Cocke County]] Mayor Rob Mathis ordering the immediate evacuation of parts of the nearby city of [[Newport, Tennessee|Newport]]. [https://www.wvlt.tv/2024/09/27/please-relocate-now-cocke-co-mayor-urges-people-evacuate/ (WVLT-TV)]. The reports were later confirmed to have been false. [https://www.knoxnews.com/story/weather/2024/09/27/cocke-county-newport-tennessee-flooding-forces-rescues-french-broad-pigeon-rivers/75414025007/ (Knoxville News Sentinel)]
***The Emergency Management department of [[Rutherford County, North Carolina|Rutherford County]], [[North Carolina]], issues a warning for the "imminent" failure of the [[Lake Lure (North Carolina)|Lake Lure Dam]] due to significant rainfall, and orders immediate evacuations. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/09/27/north-carolina-flooding-lake-lure-dam/75409116007/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[2024 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane John (2024)|Hurricane John]]
***[[Hurricane John (2024)|Tropical Storm John]] brings over {{Convert|950|mm|inches|abbr=in}} of rainfall to southern [[Guerrero]], [[Mexico]], twice eclipsing the amount of rainfall dropped by [[Hurricane Otis]] on the same area in 2023. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/tropical-storm-johns-rainfall-over-soaked-mexican-state-far-surpasses-otis-2024-09-27/ (Reuters)]
*Fifteen people are killed when an illegal [[gold mine]] collapses in [[Solok Regency]], [[West Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-gold-mine-collapses-after-landslide-killing-15-2024-09-27/ (Reuters)]
*Thirteen people are killed and 23 are injured after an explosion at a [[Filling station|fuel station]] near [[Makhachkala]], [[Dagestan]], [[Russia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/dagestan-explosion-fire-gas-station-396f8c21f8b43c8ea77bc5c7a2448b7d (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran–Israel relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Ministry]] accuses [[Israel]] of using [[United States]]-produced and gifted 5,000 lbs [[Bunker buster|bunker buster]] munitions to strike [[Hezbollah]] targets in residential areas in and around [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/irans-foreign-minister-accuses-israel-using-us-bombs-beirut-2024-09-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iraq–United States relations]], [[Operation Inherent Resolve]]
**[[Iraq]] and the [[United States]] agree to end the [[Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve|U.S.-led coalition mission]] in Iraq by September 2025, with all remaining [[United States Armed Forces|American troops]] withdrawing by the end of 2026. [https://www.reuters.com/world/coalition-military-mission-iraq-end-by-sept-2025-us-iraq-say-2024-09-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Justice Department]] charges three members of the [[Iran]]ian [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] for hacking [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] candidate [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] and "trying to disrupt the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 presidential election]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-issues-iran-related-sanctions-over-election-interference-2024-09-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Hamburg Police]] seize two tons of [[cocaine]] worth €100 million ($112 million) and arrest twelve suspects in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]], including several foreigners. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-hamburg-police-seize-2-tons-of-cocaine-worth-100m/a-70347569 (DW)]

**[[Shigeru Ishiba]] defeats [[Sanae Takaichi]] in a runoff election to become the next [[president of the Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|president of the Liberal Democratic Party]] and [[Prime Minister of Japan|prime minister]] [[Designation (law)|designate]].
